shapes.clarification: Shares, ratios and percentages are not supported yet: the service returns one aggregate query without derived arithmetic. Ask for the underlying amounts or counts (for example the amount per group and the total) and compute the share from them.

Growth rates and period-over-period changes are not supported yet: the service returns one aggregate query without derived arithmetic. Ask for the amount of each period (for example this month and last month by month) and compute the change from them.
